page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column, with page references in the right margin (P. 221. and P. 222.). Running head above the text. Catchword and gathering signature at the foot. The left strip shows the neighbouring page's edge and show-through, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: jectionibus, & NB. refutationem ALIARUM sententiarum, me non tangant magnopere. Quænam vero istæ aliæ sententiæ, quas oppugnaverat Paradoxus? quorum obiectiones erant quas solvere conatus fuit Paradoxus? Reformatorum sententia, inter alias, eorumque argumenta, & de hisce ait Wolzogius, quod se non tangant ista magnopere: imo tota sex capita, velitationi suæ cum Reformatis, impendit Paradoxus; & tamen, ea non tangunt Wolzogium: ut finem scribendi hic facere potuerit. Capite Decimo, ex Chamiero, Polano, Wendelino, Walæo, Whitakero, Tileno, Scarpio Reformatorum sententiam proponit; quam Capite undecimo explicat, additis variis adversus eandem obiectionibus: Duodecimo capite Scripturæ loca, Nehem. viii. 9. 1 Petr. 1, 20. à plerisque Reformatis Theologis & bene huc citata, suo modo explicat: Argumenta, non solum præstantissimis Theologis, sed ipsis confessionum formulis, usitata, solvere allaborat cap. xiii. Binis sequentibus capitibus, lumen & illuminationem Sp. Sancti, à Reformatis sic concipi & proponi queritur, ut Enthusiasmi ipsis dicam scribat, eorumque sententiam hac in re etiam refutandam sumat. Et hæc omnia, suâ sententiâ salvâ, intacta prætermisse potuisset noster, quia refutationem continent A L I A R U M sententiarum, quæ me, ait Wolzogius, non tangunt magnopere. Quid hinc aliter, quam aliam sibi sententiam & à Reformatis diversam, gloriari Wolzogium, colligere datur? quid est castra deserere? quid singularitatem, novitatemque affectare, si hoc non est? Unum locum addam, sic paulo post Paradoxum Pontificios, Reformatos, Socinianos, Arminianos aggressum refert: ad quæ frigidè noster: Nos vero contenti nostram proposuisse sententiam, viden', diversa igitur ipsi à Reformatis sententia est. Ne autem Pontificiis ex æquo cum Reformatis addictus videatur, sic propensiori animo hosce præ illis excipit. Et Pontificios quidem quod attinet, ne verbulo quidem eos at-P. 221.P. 222.

page.notes: Margin references "P. 221." and "P. 222." are in the right margin beside "Pontificios" and "contenti". Paragraph division: the page reads as one continuous paragraph; no clear indent was visible at the line starts, so I have not split it. The "9" at top right is uncertain. The signature "Aaa 5" is uncertain (the numeral may be s-like). The word "prætermisse" is read from a faint line; the "s" forms are uncertain. The "Aaa 5" and "tin-" at the foot are printed beneath the last line and are transcribed as the signature and catchword. The footnote line "Aaa 5 tin-" is included in main_text as a duplicate reading of the foot and should be checked, since the signature and catchword are already recorded in bottom_margin.
